title: Well-posed homogenized strain-gradient models for linear elastodynamics and elastostatics in arbitrary periodic media
summary: This work develops well-posed homogenized strain-gradient models for linear elastostatics and elastodynamics in periodic media, with a primary focus on elastic wave propagation. Using the classical two-scale asymptotic expansion method, we carry out second-order periodic homogenization for media in $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d = 2, 3$), with no restriction on the periodicity cell geometry or material distribution.
